rows.label: qst650503_msg0001
rows.name:
You cleared this challenge too?
That's impressive, mo. I've
revised my opinion of you, mo!

rows.label: qst650503_msg0002
rows.name: How many revisions is that now...?

rows.label: qst650503_msg0003
rows.name:
Mo-mo, keep saying things like that
and I won't give you the treasure, mo!

rows.label: qst650503_msg0006
rows.name:
This is... a device for an
inner suit? Why do you have
something like that...?

rows.label: qst650503_msg0007
rows.name:
Don't sweat the details,
mo. The Alst Link Device is
something to celebrate, mo!

rows.label: qst650503_msg0008
rows.name:
Is it the same sort of thing as the
rings that Shulk and Fiorung got?

rows.label: qst650503_msg0010
rows.name:
If you equip it, you'll
be able to leave here and
travel all across Alst, mo.

rows.label: qst650503_msg0011
rows.name:
I'd be able to help Rex and the others
on their quest, is that right?

rows.label: qst650503_msg0012
rows.name:
While staying in NLA... Interesting.
I can do real combat training against
all sorts of races and enemies.

rows.label: qst650503_msg0013
rows.name:
Fighting isn't all there is. I'll
show you what salvaging is like too!

rows.label: qst650503_msg0015
rows.name:
Nopon Great Sage spent 2,000 years
searching for that Alst Link Device,
so take good care of it...

rows.label: qst650503_msg0016
rows.name:
We can talk about that another
time... Come on, let's go.

rows.label: qst650503_msg0017
rows.name: Yeah, let's go to Alst together!

rows.label: qst650503_msg0018
rows.name: They didn't listen to me again, mo...
